svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Web: 10 mm plate 92 x 232 mm. It runs in the cut, behind the discs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top plate 195 x 99 x 20 mm and lower plate 195 x 79 x 20 mm,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded across the top and bottom ends of the web.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper housing 90 x 60 x 101 mm on the top plate, beside the web;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bore 57 mm on a line 49.5 mm above the nip for the eccentric bush

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (57 mm outside, 47 mm bore offset 3 mm) and one 6005 bearing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower housing 90 x 60 x 96 mm under the lower plate; bore 47 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on a line 49.5 mm below the nip for two 6005 bearings.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore both housings in one setting so the shafts are parallel

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: within 0.05 mm over 60 mm; the disc faces must meet on one plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the drop bar is welded to the top plate over the nip line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: turning the eccentric moves the upper shaft 6 mm.
